title: Refined SMP
description: A clean and polished PvP and SMP resource pack designed for smooth gameplay, refined visuals, and a familiar vanilla feel, featuring stylish textures and carefully crafted PvP optimizations.
body:
# Refined SMP

Refined SMP is a clean and polished PvP resource pack that enhances Minecraft's default look without losing its vanilla charm. selected textures and GUI elements have been refined to improve clarity, reduce visual clutter, and optimize the PvP experience while keeping the game familiar.

Designed for both SMP and competitive PvP, the pack features optimized item textures, cleaner visuals, improved GUI elements, and subtle quality-of-life enhancements that help you stay focused during combat. Whether you're grinding on your favorite server or dueling opponents, Refined SMP delivers a smooth, stylish experience without straying far from the original game.

- Features:
-   Clean, vanilla-inspired textures
-   PvP-focused optimizations
-     Low Shield & Small Totem
-     Low Fire
-     No explosion or firework particles
-     Smaller Mace & Spear
-     Smaller tools and weapons
-     Reduced grass color variation for less visual noise during movement
-     Less obstructive short grass
-     No pumpkin blur
-   Refined GUI elements
-   Lightweight and performance-friendly
-   Clean and cool art style
-   AppleSkin support
-   Perfect for SMPs, survival, and competitive gameplay

Enjoy Minecraft—refined.
